tool_args.rationale: The pilot horizons already bracket the forecast horizon. The missing evidence is how the trajectory evolves within that window: finer observations can separate fast memory relaxation from coupling strength before fitting and confirming the ODE.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter siphon-memory ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five endpoint observations give no redundancy, and all horizons are near 0.46, so the fast relaxation rate and memory coupling may trade off in the fit.
It does not resolve the uncertainty in the coupled transient.
Neither static law accounts for the observed transient lag or dependence on the initial state.
